data.name: 竿影判赎·噬月之饵
data.detailed_description:
Shadow & Atonement: The Moon's Baitis a tranquil fishing sim where the moon guides your way. This is more than a game—it's a meditative escape. Here, time slows down as you immerse yourself in a peaceful world woven from moon phases, flowing water, and the passage of time. Become a true observer of nature and a strategic angler.

Key Experiences

· A Living, Dynamic World:

Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted,lifelike ecosystem. Witness breathtaking sunrises, sunsets, and starry skies, all under the influence of a complete lunar cycle. The moon's phases are far more than a visual spectacle—they directly dictate fish activity and spawn rates. Will you seek out cautious trout in the soft morning light, or brave the unique ambiance of a full moon to challenge rare treasures lurking in the depths? Every fishing trip is a test of your timing against the heavens.

· Strategic Fishing Simulation:

Say goodbye to mindless waiting.Your wit is your ultimate bait. The game features multiple distinct waterways, from the gentle, beginner-friendly "Serene Lakeside" to the challenging "Roaring Seashore" and "Mystical Volcanic Lake," each hiding legendary species. You must become a strategist, synthesizing time (day/night), location, and the moon's phase to make the most informed decisions. Earn gold from your catch to deeply upgrade your rod, line, and tackle. Feel tangible growth as you progress from a simple pole, with each upgrade offering smoother handling and a higher chance of success.

· Zen-like Focus and Relaxation:

In our fast-paced world,this is your personal "flow state." The heart of the game is experiencing the natural rhythm of patience and reward. Free from complicated controls or stressful pressures, your world narrows to the shifting light on the water and the pure joy of a sudden tug on your line. It is the perfect sanctuary to shed your fatigue and reclaim your inner peace.

Features

· Dynamic Lunar System: The moon isn't just for show—it's the core driver of gameplay. A celestial clock that truly influences the rules of the game.

· Multiple Locations to Explore: Each fishing spot is meticulously designed with unique ecology, water colors, and exclusive fish species, encouraging continuous exploration.

· In-depth Gear Progression: Upgrades are more than just stat boosts; each new piece of equipment tangibly changes your fishing experience and strategic choices.

· Extensive Collection & Achievements: Document your unique catches through a comprehensive fish log, unlock achievements, and witness your journey from novice to Master Angler.

Welcome to this peaceful and profound world. Focus on your rod, listen to the flow of the water, and patiently await nature's bounty. All mysteries and surprises lie hidden beneath the moon's shadow and within the ripples, waiting to be reeled in by you.
